description: Output column schema for the humor model-free evidence package (no human labels). All outputs are derived from v1 operational labels and v1-v2 A/B disagreement analysis. No ground truth, gold labels, or human-adjudicated labels are defined at this stage.
constraint_note: None of these outputs contain human_label, gold_label, coder_label, adjudicated_label, or any consensus-as-ground-truth column. v1-v2 agreement is a consistency indicator, not an accuracy estimate.

humor_v1_model_free_overall_summary.csv.description: Aggregate model-free statistics from the full v1 full-chain master (68,020 rows). One row per metric.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Metric value (integer count or decimal rate)

columns.name: note
columns.description: Interpretation note and source definition for the metric

humor_v1_model_free_company_summary.csv.description: Per-company model-free statistics from the v1 full-chain master. One row per company_name.

columns.name: total_posts
columns.description: Total rows in master for this company

columns.name: aggressive_count
columns.description: humor_type == aggressive (v1 label); exploratory — no human label

columns.name: self_defeating_count
columns.description: humor_type == self_defeating (v1 label); exploratory — no human label

humor_v1_v2_disagreement_audit.csv.description: Structured audit of v1-v2 label disagreements on the 941-row A/B test sample. Multiple analysis_type sections within one file.
humor_v1_v2_disagreement_audit.csv.format: long (analysis_type / v1_label / v2_label / transition_type / count / share)
analysis_types: transition_type_summary — one row per transition_type with total count and share
v1_v2_cross_tab — one row per (v1_label, v2_label) pair with count and per-v1-label share
ambiguous_resolution — v2 label distribution for v1-ambiguous rows
rare_class_transition — (v1,v2) pairs involving aggressive or self_defeating

columns.name: v1_label
columns.description: v1 humor type label (empty for transition_type_summary rows)

columns.name: v2_label
columns.description: v2 humor type label (empty for transition_type_summary rows)

columns.name: count
columns.description: Number of rows matching this analysis row

columns.name: share_of_v1_label
columns.description: count / all rows with this v1_label; empty where not applicable

humor_rare_class_sensitivity_summary.csv.description: Focused sensitivity summary for aggressive and self_defeating rare humor types. All values are exploratory — no human labels exist.

columns.name: interpretation
columns.description: Interpretation note including caution about no human label

humor_no_human_label_evidence_manifest.j.description: Run manifest for the evidence package. Records source files, output paths, row counts, and constraint flags.

constraints_flags.no_human_label: bool — always true in this package
